stem: Which sentence from the excerpt best illustrates Noah's conflict?

options.label: A
options.text: My mother insisted that I write a B & B letter to my grandparents.

options.label: B
options.text: "Is Joey writing a B & B to Grandma and Grandpa Eberle?"

options.label: C
options.text: She explained—not too patiently—that a B & B letter is a bread and butter letter you write to people to thank them for having you as their houseguest.

options.label: D
options.text: My brother Joey had been sent to my other set of grandparents, who live in a normal suburb in Connecticut.
